articles.mainIdea: The Cigna Group Foundation Opens 2026 Youth Mental Health Grant Program To Support Youth, Families and Communities
articles.summary: PR Newswire: The Cigna Group Foundation Opens 2026 Youth Mental Health Grant Program To Support Youth, Families and Communities. The Cigna Group Foundation, the philanthropic arm of The Cigna Group (NYSE: CI), has opened its 2026 Improving Youth Mental Health grant program. Nonprofit organizations are invited to apply now through March 12 at 5:00 pm ET.
